title: Line Nine
intro: A phone that rings for no one. The lantern is lit.
body: I work nights at the Calder Road call centre. At 3:07, line nine lit up. Line nine was disconnected years ago. I answered anyway. A woman's voice whispered, "You left the back door open." I live alone. I opened my security camera. The back door was open, and the kitchen light was on.
outro: Some calls are better left unanswered. Would you have picked up?
narration:
A phone that rings for no one. The lantern is lit.

I work nights at the Calder Road call centre. At 3:07, line nine lit up. Line nine was disconnected years ago. I answered anyway. A woman's voice whispered, "You left the back door open." I live alone. I opened my security camera. The back door was open, and the kitchen light was on.

Some calls are better left unanswered. Would you have picked up?
